## Checklist before merging / 合并前检查

Thank you for your contribution to the repository. 
Before submitting this PR, please make sure:

- [ ] The client build passes without errors or warnings / 客户端构建无错误和警告
- [ ] Code follows the [LeviLamina C++ Style Guide](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLamina/wiki/CPP-Style-Guide) / 遵循 LeviLamina C++ 风格
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes / 空白检查通过
- [ ] Relevant tests or target-client validation are complete / 已完成相关测试或目标客户端验证
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation is synchronized when needed / 需要时已同步英文和中文文档
- [ ] No unlicensed code or assets were added / 未加入无许可证代码或资源
- [ ] Third-party notices are included when required / 必要时已添加第三方声明
